import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_87/training_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes
dfs = []

# Load each source file
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the same schema as the target, we union (concatenate) them
# In this case, there is only one source file, so this is trivial
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the target schema and types:
# Target schema: ['condition': integer, 'click': float]
combined_df = combined_df[['condition', 'click']]  # project columns in order

# Convert types explicitly
combined_df['condition'] = combined_df['condition'].astype(int)
combined_df['click'] = combined_df['click'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
combined_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_87/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
